title: Just okay
text: Just okay. This is a beautiful skillet. I love the helper handle at the top and the long cool-to-touch handle at the base. Also nice are the 2 pour spouts on each side.  It’s not as heavy as a traditional cast iron skillet and the enamel job is perfect. I was so excited to use it! However, it didn’t perform as well as I expected. First off, the black part is textured. It’s very strange. My food stuck to it and when I tried to clean it with my cast iron cleaner, I scratched it. Second, it was the slowest skillet ever to heat up. I cooked shrimp on this and I swear the pan took 15 minutes to heat and cook. I was shocked. I had it on medium high heat. My other cast iron skillet cooks shrimp in 2 minutes. Third, the heat distribution was very poor. All the heat was super concentrated on the very inside. All the food on the outside was totally raw and never browned. I’m used to having to rearrange food in the skillet to ensure even cooking, but have never used such a poor performer. I can’t recommend this skillet. It’s designed well and is very attractive. But as far as cooking in it, there are many other better choices in all other price brackets.

product_metadata.title: Larder & Vine Enameled Cast Iron Skillet | Nonstick Frying Pan – No Seasoning Required | Ergonomic and Helper Handle, Pour Spouts 10.25 inch / 27cm (Bondi)
features: Oven Safe Skillet is cast iron, with colorful enamel coating. The colorful enamel is shock resistant to prevent chipping and cracking and makes it easy to clean.
It delivers superior, even heat distribution and retention. Ready to use, no seasoning is required. Use for frying, sauteing and searing. It's perfect for cooking everything from eggs to steaks.
Compatible with all cooktops and oven safe up to 500°F.

From stove to oven to table. Shortened handle with thumb groove, along with a support handle allow for a better grip and more control when using the skillet. Pour spouts on both sides make it easy to pour out/strain any liquids.
Pair this with our 5.7 quart Dutch Oven. The Dutch oven lid fits perfectly on this cast iron pan.
